Results.ReviewText: Fantastic! I love everything about this grill. I have avoided buying a Weber for decades because of the price. I was soooo wrong. In every way it is so much better than any other grill I've ever owned - quality and performance. I was a little nervous about going smaller (so less of a $$$ shock), but this has proven to be just the right size. Because everything on the grilling surface is easily accessible it has as much practical grilling space as those with a larger surface area. It heats up much quicker, cooks more evenly, cleans easy, doesn't rust (with cover against rain), and even seems to use less propane.
Results.Title: Fantastic!

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Spirit II E-210 grill last summer. It's the perfect size for me, I really like it. I do have one complaint though. The wheels on it are on the wrong side of the body. They way it's made, they're on the same side that the fixed tray is on. You would normally pick up from the opposite side, but there is no place to hold onto anything on the opposite side, making it very difficult to move around. There is a tray on that oppisite side, but it's not fixed, so when you attempt to pick it up, the tray comes off. If it wasn't for this, what I call a design flaw, I would have given it 5 stars.
Results.Title: Exellent grill!

Results.ReviewText: A very nice BBQ. I always look forward to using the my new WEBER grill. It looks so nice and new. I wish the wheels and axle were a little sturdier. I also thought WEBER should have kept there name on the wheels as did my previous WEBER grill. Oh, I love the Blueish covered hood. I am looking forward to another 10 years of grilling with this grill. I know that with the 10 year warranty I will be covered by WEBER and that makes me happy. One item I would like to share: Make sure you attach the propane tank to the hose and grill before you move it. After I attached the hose to the tank I accidentally forgot to attach the tank to the grill. This caused the full propane tank to fall over. I checked everything and all seems to be OK. Happy WEBER Grilling!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
